newsitem.title: USA: Gilead starts clinical trials of PMPA.
newsitem.headline: Gilead starts clinical trials of PMPA.

text.p: Gilead Sciences Inc said it began human clinical trials of PMPA as a treatment for HIV.
It said the test is a combined Phase I/II double-blind, placebo controlled human study to assess the safety, tolerance and effectiveness of PMPA as an intravenous treatment for HIV-infected patients.

It said PMPA is chemically similar to another Gilead nucleotide product candidate, GS 840, which is now in pivotal Phase II/III human clinical testing as an HIV treatment. Gilead said PMPA has already demonstrated potent activity in primates.
